summary: Input discovery and validation: SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS (12 audio + 8 video container suffixes), is_supported() case-insensitive suffix check, and collect_inputs() turning user paths into resolved, deduplicated, sorted media lists — missing paths raise AudioNotFoundError, explicit unsupported files raise UnsupportedFormatError listing formats, directory scans (flat or recursive) keep supported files and skip hidden entries, empty results raise. 38 offline tmp_path tests cover the full contract.
